exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Receiving something in a humble manner".

options.text: A とか B とか
Nounをいただく
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Nounをいただく matches "Receiving something in a humble manner".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Nounをいただく.
exercises.explanation: Expresses humbly receiving something from someone; polite form of "もらう".
